patch.value: GH-672: pm context low_level rows omit blocked state and blocker IDs
pm context summary reports blocked work but low_level rows omit a blocked marker and blocker IDs, forcing agents to spend another command roundtrip to understand actionability.

Context low_level rows include a token-efficient blocked marker and blocker IDs; SDK and CLI projections share one implementation; bounded/default output remains within token budgets; context summary and rows cannot disagree; contracts docs and tests cover active terminal missing and custom-status blockers
Each low_level context row exposes compact blocked state and blocker IDs consistently with the summary and pm next semantics.
The summary reports blocked items while low_level rows do not identify which rows are blocked or why.
